segments.text: Hey, what's going on guys? My name is Alex. I'm with SoCal Contractor Exchange. I work here because
this is a great place to work for. The culture is amazing. Shai is by far the best guy I've ever
worked for. He has a bonus structure that's just out of this world. I mean, you come here every day.
It's a set schedule. We go to great neighborhoods. We just knock it out of the park and Shai hooks
us up, man. It's a great place to be working. I love it here. Things to be successful here at
door knocking is just having a positive attitude, not taking things personal with people because
there's some people who will knock you down. You just kind of get back up on your feet. Just go to
the next house. You know, every place is a new start and just keep going and you'll just keep
getting better and better and just be in a good mindset.
